title: The Morning Digest: November 10, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $92.57 on Monday, down $5.75 or 5.9 percent, its lowest settle since Aug 31, and WTI Dec26 settled at $86.85, down $4.38 percent (Bloomberg via Rigzone, Nov 9), with Tuesday's Asian session lower again at $90.99 and $85.20 on the latest Reuters snapshot (0759 GMT). The presidential meeting with the Qatari prime minister produced no agreement and no lifting of the naval blockade: strikes are on hold, the blockade stays, and the two-day bridge proposal was not accepted. The Brent to WTI spread compressed to $5.72. December WCS is -$28.91 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 9) on zero lots, a third straight zero-lot tightening, while January traded 620 lots at -$23.35. The validated diesel crack is $86.94.
